“Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God…

translations.web: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”
translations.bsb: Choose for yourselves wise, understanding, and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will appoint them as your leaders.”
translations.kjv: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers
translations.asv: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known, according to your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.
